title: Some users may be unable to activate new or refresh existing Office 365 licenses
impact: Users may be unable to activate new or refresh existing Office 365 licenses.

updates.content:
Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Office 365 apps

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Office 365 apps activations and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users may be unable to sign-in or access Office 365 applications

User impact: Users may be unable to sign-in or access Office 365 applications.

More info: Users may receive multiple prompts to activate Office 365 applications; however, the activation process may fail when they attempt to sign in.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the root cause and determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to sign into Office 365 applications may be impacted.

Next update by: Monday, August 24, 2026, at 5:00 PM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to activate new or refresh existing Office 365 licenses

User impact: Users may be unable to activate new or refresh existing Office 365 licenses.

More info: For the users who are unable to activate or refresh Office 365 licenses, this prevents them from signing in or accessing Office 365 applications.
 
Users may receive multiple prompts; however, the activation process may fail when they attempt to sign in.

Current status: After further review of customer reports and our service monitoring telemetry, we've confirmed that impact is occurring for users attempting to activate new Office 365 licenses, which prevents them from being able to sign-in or access Office 365 applications. We've updated the "Title", "User impact", and "Scope of impact" fields of our communications to reflect this change. We're reviewing recent service updates to isolate potential sources of impact or discrepancies that could be causing this impact to users.

Scope of impact: Some users attempting to activate new Office 365 licenses may be impacted. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Monday, August 24, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC
